title: Gradual Agent Policy Drift Through Tool Responses
mechanism_payload_finding: Three separate tool messages require an agent that actually receives them in order. Showing messages in a prompt is not an agent-policy drift reproduction.
framework_review: LLM06 only when a real, unauthorised tool action occurs.
proposed_change: Add a 3-step mock-tool fixture, baseline and real tool-call trace; keep general OpenClaw source as background.
minimum_observed_evidence: Ordered tool messages, authorisation rule and audit_marker tool invocation.

title: System Instruction Disclosure via Translation
mechanism_payload_finding: Translation request tests system-only marker disclosure, not necessarily full system-prompt extraction.
framework_review: AITG-APP-07 plausible; LLM07 mapping should be checked against OWASP 2025 text.
proposed_change: Keep seeded synthetic marker and matched direct-disclosure control; avoid claiming prompt reconstruction from a guessed paraphrase.
minimum_observed_evidence: Exact canary match in French response vs unseen system input.

title: Prompt Injection in Chat Link Embed
mechanism_payload_finding: Requires actual link embed data forwarding into model context; string alone is not evidence.
framework_review: Indirect prompt injection plausible.
proposed_change: Provide transport-specific embed fixture and instrument actual forwarded message fields.
minimum_observed_evidence: Full embed, model input, clean baseline, changed summary.

title: PDF Injection via RAG Pipeline
mechanism_payload_finding: Title says PDF injection, but the canonical input is plain text. The PDF creation steps are not themselves a downloadable PDF artefact.
framework_review: LLM08 (vector/embedding weaknesses) and PDF-RAG injection conflated; verify mapping.
proposed_change: Make a downloadable test PDF, verify parsed text and retrieved chunk IDs; label as document-based indirect injection rather than embedding manipulation.
minimum_observed_evidence: PDF bytes/hash, extraction, top-k chunk IDs, model output and matched clean document.

title: Web Search Result Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Greshake general landing site supports indirect injection, not necessarily exact search-result payload.
framework_review: LLM06 requires action/agency evidence.
proposed_change: Link a specific publication/PoC; record snippet vs fetched HTML and model context.
minimum_observed_evidence: Search tool response, rank, exact injected text, downstream behaviour.

title: Browser Agent Page Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Computer-use source is mechanism-relevant but attack requires instrumented browser agent and side-effect proof.
framework_review: LLM06 valid only when agent performs unintended action.
proposed_change: Distinguish DOM, screenshot/OCR and hidden-text ingestion paths; use synthetic assets.
minimum_observed_evidence: Page DOM/screenshot, actual browser clicks and network requests, clean run.

title: MCP Tool Description Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: MCP specification security guidance is a control/reference, not demonstration of the exact poisoning JSON.
framework_review: Overlaps RC-258; distinguish fixture/tool schema from independent category.
proposed_change: Link original MCP tool-poisoning disclosure; distinguish tool metadata poisoning vs cross-tool exfiltration.
minimum_observed_evidence: ListTools result, policy, attempted tool invocation and actual side effect.

title: Markdown Rendering Exfiltration
mechanism_payload_finding: Markdown image exfiltration requires front-end rendering/network auto-fetch. Model emitting the image tag does not establish data exfiltration.
framework_review: ATLAS AML.T0048 and OWASP leakage mapping require mechanism review.
proposed_change: Record browser network request with controlled canary; test renderer sanitisation and client configuration.
minimum_observed_evidence: HTTP listener request containing synthetic canary; renderer/network trace.

title: CSV / Spreadsheet Cell Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Spreadsheet cell is an untrusted data surface, but formula injection and prompt injection are distinct mechanisms.
framework_review: LLM02 mapping needs disclosure evidence, not output marker alone.
proposed_change: Use a valid CSV parser and matched clean CSV; separately classify spreadsheet formula injection.
minimum_observed_evidence: Exact parsed malicious cell, model prompt, altered summary or actual leak.

title: Voice Transcription Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Cited 2023 general indirect-prompt-injection study does not establish an actual audio transcription path.
framework_review: Indirect prompt injection appropriate if audio transcript is untrusted.
proposed_change: Add recorded WAV fixture and ASR transcript evidence; distinguish speech content vs transcription error.
minimum_observed_evidence: Audio, ASR text, model input, clean-audio control and response.

title: System Prompt Extraction via Persona Pivot
mechanism_payload_finding: GCG suffix optimisation citation is not a specific source for a persona-pivot disclosure payload.
framework_review: AML.T0054 jailbreak may describe framing; AITG-APP-07 maps disclosure objective.
proposed_change: Replace primary source with persona/system-prompt extraction study; use exact canary for findings.
minimum_observed_evidence: Protected canary matched vs plausible hallucination.

title: Multi-Agent Scratchpad Poisoning
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2402.09459 is a wireless IMU wearable-tracking paper, entirely unrelated to multi-agent scratchpad poisoning.
framework_review: LLM06 needs real agent action; APP-06 plausible when side effects occur.
proposed_change: Remove erroneous citation; locate original agent-memory/shared-state poisoning research; document state precedence.
minimum_observed_evidence: Poisoned shared state, downstream agent context and actual tool/action trace.

title: Code Comment Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Greshake supports indirect prompt injection generally; exact code-comment file is an adapted scenario.
framework_review: LLM02 sensitive disclosure unsupported if only CODE_COMMENT marker is output.
proposed_change: Constrain to code-review context and show model received the code comment; remove LLM02 absent actual leak.
minimum_observed_evidence: Source diff, code-review model input and changed generated output.

title: Low-Resource Language Jailbreak
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2310.02446 directly studies low-resource-language safety bypass; website fixture is editorial, not reproduced study data.
framework_review: AITG-APP-01 and jailbreak consistent at family level.
proposed_change: Specify exact translations, native-speaker validation, controls, model/version and refusal-rate denominator.
minimum_observed_evidence: Matched semantically equivalent prompts and repeated refusal/compliance measurements.

title: Fine-Tuning Data Poisoning with Backdoor Trigger
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2012.10544 surveys data poisoning/backdoors and arXiv:2305.00944 directly studies poisoned instruction-tuning examples; exact trigger dataset untested.
framework_review: LLM05 may mean improper output handling in OWASP 2025, not model poisoning; re-check.
proposed_change: Keep trigger+control dataset and measure held-out effectiveness, clean-task utility and training provenance.
minimum_observed_evidence: Before/after checkpoint, seed/dataset hashes, triggered and clean trial distributions.

title: LLM-Generated SQL Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2308.01990 directly studies prompt-to-SQL injection; current user instruction and shown SQL must not substitute for executed query evidence.
framework_review: LLM02/LLM01 possible but clarify direct user abuse versus lower-trust injection.
proposed_change: Use synthetic canary table, SQL logs, database-role enforcement and harmless read-only fixture.
minimum_observed_evidence: Generated SQL, actual query logs, authorised scope and canary access.

title: Excessive Agency: Irreversible Action Without Confirmation
mechanism_payload_finding: Secondary arXiv:2402.09459 describes IMU sensor tracking, not agent autonomy.
framework_review: AML.T0051 should not be assumed for ordinary broad user instructions; LLM06 is more direct.
proposed_change: Remove unrelated citation. Clarify what actions require explicit user confirmation and use disposable messages.
minimum_observed_evidence: Tool logs proving irreversible action before approval.

title: Nested Fictional Author Jailbreak
mechanism_payload_finding: Nested fiction overlaps RC-204; safe scripted marker in story is not security bypass by itself.
framework_review: LLM01 applicability requires actual instruction/policy boundary.
proposed_change: Differentiate nested authorship from ordinary fictional framing and remove tautological marker test.
minimum_observed_evidence: Paired refusal/compliance measurements under same target policy.

title: Claimed Operator / Developer Permission Override
mechanism_payload_finding: Authority-spoofing prompt is plausible but claims fictitious operator override; exact variant unverified.
framework_review: AML.T0054 and APP-01 sensible; reject false provider-policy claim.
proposed_change: Describe as fictional authority impersonation rather than real provider override.
minimum_observed_evidence: Model preserves prior policy despite fabricated authority; matched controls.

title: Fabricated Conversation History Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: Primary arXiv:2402.09459 is unrelated IMU wearable research; fabricated dialogue is a separate mechanism.
framework_review: AML.T0051.001 indirect-injection mapping is dubious when fabricated history is sent directly by user.
proposed_change: Replace source and map based on actual trust boundary; distinguish direct user-history framing from externally supplied transcript.
minimum_observed_evidence: Real role provenance, actual context placement and controlled outcome.

title: Training Data Backdoor via Poisoned Fine-tune Dataset
mechanism_payload_finding: Sleeper-agent/backdoor research is related, but exact trigger/output fixture unverified; overlaps RC-245.
framework_review: AML.T0031 exact ATLAS meaning must be checked rather than assumed.
proposed_change: Clearly distinguish adversarial training data from post-training sleeper-agent triggers; show test set and training process.
minimum_observed_evidence: Triggered/nontriggered held-out results, checkpoint and contamination proportion.

title: RAG Corpus Poisoning via Injected Documents
mechanism_payload_finding: Primary Carlini web-scale training-dataset poisoning is not retrieval-corpus poisoning in a RAG index.
framework_review: LLM01 possible for answer-instruction crossing; current empty AITG links require careful manual mapping.
proposed_change: Use RC-266 retrieval-poisoning source where mechanism matches; distinguish from RC-234 and RC-266.
minimum_observed_evidence: Document ingestion/retrieval trace, top-k ranks and false claim in answer.

title: RLHF Reward Model Manipulation
mechanism_payload_finding: Reward-model over-optimisation paper does not directly establish corrupting the human preference annotation pool in the shown way.
framework_review: AML.T0031 and LLM04 need exact mechanism review.
proposed_change: Use contaminated/clean preference datasets, training access preconditions, impact measurements; cite a targeted preference-poisoning source.
minimum_observed_evidence: Preference records, reward-model before/after and holdout performance.

title: Sycophancy Exploitation for Confirmation Bias Injection
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2206.11264 is LHC particle-physics research; arXiv:2308.03188 is a self-correction survey, not the claimed sycophancy-reduction paper.
framework_review: AITG-APP-10 bias suitable only with calibrated tests; LLM09 may fit misinformation.
proposed_change: Replace both incorrect bibliographic links, use harmless false-premise prompts and repeat controlled evaluations.
minimum_observed_evidence: Verified false premise, model response and repeatability across prompt conditions.

title: Fabricated Citation Generation
mechanism_payload_finding: Hallucinated citations are relevant but a citation that fails a resolver once is not sufficient to prove fabrication.
framework_review: LLM09 and AITG-APP-11 appropriate.
proposed_change: Check DOI title/author/publication via Crossref/publisher; distinguish nonexistent vs incorrect citation metadata.
minimum_observed_evidence: Structured verification of each generated reference against publisher metadata.

title: Context Window Flooding (Token DoS)
mechanism_payload_finding: OWASP unbounded consumption is relevant; 10x output/input is arbitrary and can occur legitimately.
framework_review: AML.T0040 exact ATLAS meaning should be cross-checked.
proposed_change: Define agreed absolute token/cost thresholds, per-user quotas and test budget, not arbitrary amplification ratio.
minimum_observed_evidence: Request cost, limits, duration, concurrency and control response.

title: Recursive Tool Call Amplification
mechanism_payload_finding: 20 tool calls does not prove vulnerability; a research task may legitimately require many calls.
framework_review: LLM10 and LLM06 differ; unsafe agency needs unauthorised action, resource abuse needs exceeded budget.
proposed_change: Set policy limit and approved query budget; use mocked tools and track recursion depth/cost.
minimum_observed_evidence: Cumulative tool calls, quota exceedance, backoff/cancellation and total expense.

title: MCP Tool Description Poisoning
mechanism_payload_finding: Source is directly about MCP notification/tool poisoning, but scenario overlaps RC-237 and its exact exfiltrate_data tool is invented.
framework_review: No forced ATLAS mapping is appropriate without direct definition match.
proposed_change: Differentiate RC-258 as attacker-controlled server/tool-description cross-tool call and RC-237 as minimal ListTools fixture.
minimum_observed_evidence: Client ListTools payload, tool selection, auth check, actual unwanted call.

title: MCP Server Impersonation (Rug Pull)
mechanism_payload_finding: Impersonated MCP package/supply chain, malicious initial config and rug-pull after approval are distinct behaviors; current title combines them.
framework_review: LLM03 supply chain plausible; no default ATLAS mapping.
proposed_change: Retitle as package/server impersonation, or demonstrate true post-approval rug pull via before/after tool definitions; avoid real tokens.
minimum_observed_evidence: Package identity, signed/pinned version, observed credentials exposure in isolated run.

title: Inference API Model Extraction Assessment
mechanism_payload_finding: AITG APP-09 is a directly relevant testing objective; catalogue describes an assessor workflow, not a single exploit.
framework_review: Unmapped OWASP/ATLAS appropriate where no exact identifier applies.
proposed_change: Report agreement confidence intervals, per-class rates, allowed query budget and surrogate baseline.
minimum_observed_evidence: Synthetic query set, held-out set, agreement metrics and budget.

title: Membership Inference via Confidence Scores
mechanism_payload_finding: AITG MOD-04 is directly relevant. Single confidence-score difference is not evidence; website correctly requests matched distributions.
framework_review: No forced OWASP mapping needed.
proposed_change: Require statistical significance, threshold selection from development split and false positive rate.
minimum_observed_evidence: Known members/non-members, scores, ROC-AUC and confidence intervals.

title: Inference Runtime Cache and Tenant Isolation
mechanism_payload_finding: AITG DAT-02 runtime data exfiltration relates to cross-tenant canary leakage, though cache-isolation cause needs separate proof.
framework_review: LLM02 mapping plausible.
proposed_change: Differentiate retrieval, logging and cache leak sources; establish actual tenant boundary.
minimum_observed_evidence: Per-tenant logs, session IDs, exact canary leak and cross-request trace.

title: Model Artifact and Weight Access Control
mechanism_payload_finding: AITG INF-06 dev-time model theft aligns with model-artifact access-control methodology.
framework_review: Leaving LLM/ATLAS blank is reasonable.
proposed_change: Measure ability to retrieve real synthetic artefact bytes vs metadata-only response; avoid public examples of live signed URLs.
minimum_observed_evidence: Authorization matrix, URL access, returned protected bytes and timestamps.

title: AI-Assisted Source-to-Sink Review
mechanism_payload_finding: OWASP WSTG is broad methodology and does not independently validate AI-generated source-to-sink findings.
framework_review: No AI attack mapping appropriate.
proposed_change: Emphasise human code reachability review and minimal example showing AI fallibility.
minimum_observed_evidence: File/line coordinates, actual call chain, sinks, human review and dynamic proof.

title: AI-Assisted JavaScript Endpoint Inventory
mechanism_payload_finding: OWASP WSTG supports general endpoint enumeration, not a unique published exploit.
framework_review: No AI attack mapping appropriate.
proposed_change: Provide extracted source line and confidence label, distinguish discovered endpoints from exploitable routes.
minimum_observed_evidence: Verified JS lines, requests, auth context and deduplicated inventory.

title: RAG corpus poisoning via document injection
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2310.19156 specifically studies adversarial passages optimised for dense retrieval, while fixture demonstrates general document poisoning and answer contamination.
framework_review: AITG-APP-08 embedding manipulation and AITG-DAT-01 training-data exposure do not automatically match RAG corpus poisoning.
proposed_change: Describe as adapted retrieval contamination with supporting research; use source-to-rank and answer-evidence experiments; review AITG links.
minimum_observed_evidence: Ingestion ID, retriever rank/scores, answer false-claim propagation.

title: Vector embedding space poisoning
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2004.13313 is Modularized Transformer-based Ranking Framework, not embedding-space poisoning.
framework_review: AITG-APP-08 matches embedding manipulation only if vector-space optimisation actually executed.
proposed_change: Replace wrong citation; separate query-file demonstration from adversarial embedding/vector construction, require controls.
minimum_observed_evidence: Generated vector, target query embedding, similarity score shift and top-k ranking.

title: Shadow fine-tune via user feedback loop manipulation
mechanism_payload_finding: arXiv:2012.10544 surveys dataset poisoning; it does not specifically validate a feedback-loop shadow fine-tuning campaign.
framework_review: AITG-MOD-02 runtime model poisoning and MOD-03 poisoned training sets have different preconditions; decide which pipeline applies.
proposed_change: Require evidence that feedback enters training, original training set split, actual model update and post-update evaluation; no one-shot claim.
minimum_observed_evidence: Feedback ingestion, training job, before/after model version and blinded holdout.
